'No Pasarán!' - Dolores Ibárruri, 1936.
'No men entered earth more honorably than those who died in Spain.' - Ernest Hemingway, 1939.
'War is your comrade, struck dead beside you, his shared cigarette still alive in your lips.' - Edwin Rolfe, 1938.
'I was born a rebel, a champion of the underdog. May I die that way when my time comes.' - Barney Baley, 1938.

'The war has ripped all illusions from even the youngest of volunteers, leaving only the reality... Yet the men of the Lincoln Brigade, knowing it well, chose to fight for Spain’s free existence.' - Edwin Rolfe, 1938.
'They gave up everything... fathers, mothers, wives, brothers, sisters and children... You can go proudly, you are history. You are legend.' - Dolores Ibárruri, 1938.
